sql: WITH despesa AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_liquidado AS DECIMAL)) AS total_despesa FROM educacao_educacao WHERE ano_referencia = 2023), receita AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_realizadoateperiodo AS DECIMAL)) AS total_receita FROM receita_receita WHERE ano_referencia = 2023 AND dsc_especie ILIKE '%Imposto%') SELECT (total_despesa / NULLIF(total_receita, 0)) * 100 AS indice_educacao, total_despesa, total_receita, (total_despesa >= (0.25 * total_receita)) AS atingiu_minimo_constitucional FROM despesa, receita;
